items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1962-08-26
items.q: I can't remember the names. I'm not sure.

ctx.x: I'm sure one of them was Guy Kelly and the other one, I can't remember his name. Guy Kelly was a tough, hard to get along with Negro and the other fellow was an easygoing fellow. Both of them were top-notch cornet players, trumpet players.
Would it have been Chris Kelly by any chance? Do you remember? It was Guy Kelly. Was it Chris Kelly of Blue? Oh, I really,
I can't remember the names. I'm not sure. I know this, that they both played in Celestine's band at the same time. I don't know,
